integrity: Self-contained analytic proof and exact rational-arithmetic finite checker; first public source date is for arXiv:0902.1156, not a journal publication date. Independent mathematical audit has not occurred.
scientific_limitations: Finite weighted spider trees with positive arm-edge lengths and strictly positive vertex masses; real-valued unit-Lipschitz observables; compact rational encoding for complexity. No result for branched arms, zero masses, other moments, or strong NP-hardness. Indexed-only comparisons leave possible unindexed equivalences.
title: Sharp Lipschitz variance on weighted spider metrics: complete arm rigidity and signed radial discrepancy
